examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Hover or Tab to the dotted term to open it. The panel is closed until the reader asks for it — a gloss never opens on its own.

examples.name: Kinds
examples.summary: The two a11y contracts side by side. The first panel is a `role="tooltip"` and its trigger takes `aria-describedby`; the second carries a link, so it is a `role="dialog"` announced through `aria-expanded`, named by its headline, and enterable with Tab. Tab again from inside it and focus returns to the term.
